plain.li: Another year on the rim. Most of us are still here. That's the whole of it, really.
I don't know what next year brings. Something with teeth, probably. We'll manage.
[annals:losses] We lost people this year. Write their names somewhere they'll last longer than this paper.
[annals:violent] We spent half the year with a gun in one hand. I'd like next year to need fewer hands.
[annals:peaceful] A quiet year. I don't trust it, but I'll take it.
[annals:richer] We have more than we did. Raiders can count too. Keep the walls up.
[annals:growing] More mouths, more hands, more arguments over the last biscuit. Good.
[winter] Snow on the windowsill as I write this. We made it through another one.

warm.li: Whatever happens next year, I'm glad it's with all of you.
[annals:losses] I keep their places at the table in my head. I think I always will.
[annals:growing] So many new faces. I hope they feel at home here. I hope we let them.

blunt.li: That's the year. Most of it was mud. Next.
[annals:violent] They keep coming. We keep burying them. Fine by me.
[annals:peaceful] Nothing tried to kill us. Somebody check the sky for falling ships.

cheerful.li: What a year! Terrible in places! Wonderful in others! Same again, please, minus the terrible!
[annals:richer] We're practically rich! Well. Richer. Someone should buy a hat!
[annals:peaceful] Not a single raid! I'm going to frame this page!

gloomy.li: Another year closer to the end. At least it was our year.
[annals:losses] The graveyard got bigger. It always does.
[annals:violent] I've stopped counting the raids in my head. I only count who's left.

cold.li: Summary complete. Survival rate acceptable. Recommend continuing.
[annals:losses] Losses were within expectations. Replace them.
[annals:richer] Assets grew. So will the size of the next raid. Plan accordingly.
